concerns: JSON-LD end date is wrong (1-2 April); the visible header and the compliance line both say three days. Header range wins when it starts on the same day.

Offer-end year assumed to be the congress year (January 14, 2027); the page prints no year. Abstract dates also have no year and take the year before the congress when they would otherwise fall after it.
The EUR 490 yearly AMS Premium membership on /register/ is a subscription, not an event fee, and is skipped. Group discount (10+ delegates) not priced.
